Title: Azure Machine Learning Announcements – January 2022 General Availability Announcement

Body.Content:
Multiple private endpoint support enables you to set up common scenarios for more complex virtual network (VNet) architecture. For example, you can establish private endpoint integration between a private link enabled workspace and other Azure services such as Synapse or Data Factory. 

With storage account IP firewall support by Azure Machine Learning, you have the flexibility to let the public users use the data in storage behind the virtual network without configuring the private link enabled workspace.

Learn how to secure workspace resources using virtual networks (VNets)

Learn how to configure a private endpoint for an Azure Machine Learning workspace.
